program.name: 530A ("Trump") Accounts
program.description:
A 530A ("Trump") Account is a savings and investment account for your child. The government adds a one-time $1,000 contribution to help the account grow.

The money stays invested so it can grow over the years. An adult manages the account while the child is under 18. After that, the account works more like a regular retirement account.

Your child will need a valid Social Security Number to open the account and get the $1,000 contribution. If your child does not have one yet, you can apply for one at ssa.gov.

Each child can have only one initial Trump Account. To get started, select "Fill out Form 4547" to sign in to your IRS account and submit the Trump Account election.
